roles: From the data model to the interface
hero.lead: I design and build the whole system: the data model, the API that exposes it, and the interface — web, mobile or desktop — the end user actually works with.

about.label: 01 — Profile
about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a Higher Technician in Programming and a full-stack developer. I work across a product's full cycle: I map the real business process, model the database, build the API and develop the interface the client uses.
about.p2: Most of what I've built is in production solving concrete processes: purchase approval workflows, livestock traceability and order taking integrated with an ERP. I care about software that works offline, syncs reliably and doesn't get in the way of the people using it.
about.point1: Integration with existing management systems over REST APIs
about.point4: A single codebase for web, mobile and desktop
about.s1Text: Relational modeling, SQL queries, REST APIs, authentication and server-side business rules.
about.s2Text: Responsive and accessible interfaces, API consumption, dashboards and admin panels.
about.s3Text: Cross-platform applications with local storage, offline usage and deferred synchronization.
